caption: The drawing depicts a single brown glass bottle centered on a light beige background with softly shaded areas around the bottle, suggesting a subtle shadow or aura. The bottle has a rectangular base with slightly rounded corners and a decorative, twisted or ribbed neck leading to a capped top. Embossed on the front of the bottle, within a laurel wreath, are the words “McHENRY” and “1812,” with the intertwined letters “JM” in the center of the wreath. The bottle displays highlights and reflections typical of glass, showing a range of brown hues from dark to light, with shading indicating the thickness and curvature of the glass. The overall composition is vertically oriented, and the entirety of the bottle is visible and centrally positioned.
title: McHenry Bottle
